name: fix109_shield_animals
verifies: fix-109 [owner] option "Shield protects from beasts" (UP 1.04 rule, ShieldCreatureParade): off (CP 1.75 original) a wolf's bites go through the raised shield (CanParadeMoveOf: a non-humanoid fist-mode attacker is never parried); on, the raised shield blocks them (stamina only, AAI: no shortfall damage), a weapon-only parade still does not, and a troll's blows go through the shield
steps: safe; god; notips; time 12; level 20; attr STR 200
spawn Wolf attitude=hostile dist=8 side=front as=w
spawn Wolf attitude=hostile dist=8 side=front as=w2
spawn Wolf attitude=hostile dist=8 side=front as=w3
spawn Troll attitude=hostile dist=10 side=front as=t
notes: Not run (no editor in fix-109). touches = bites/blows that reached the hero during the held block, hurtby = their damage (god mode refills HP). Parts: 1 option off + shield (G3: hurt), 2 option on + shield (blocked, hurtby 0), 3 option on, sword only (hurt), 4 option on + shield vs Troll (UP: trolls are never blocked, hurt). The wolf starts 8 m away so the block is up before its first bite (fix-85).
